083ea102.text:
It pains us to mention that we at Snuff Inc. have received reports that some greedy tuber hunters care little for the safety of their lovable pets and send them into dark, dangerous nooks and cranies in search of tubers.

We do not condone such irresponsible behavior, but in the efforts of customer satisfaction we have included a warranty with every gopher sold, allowing new owners to return to their point of purchase and replace lost pets.

Happy Hunting!
083ea102.title: Snufflenose Owner's Manual

6bb719a7.text:
WALKING YOUR GOPHER

The snufflenose gopher likes small, dark places.  And it is very shy.

If you wish to walk your gopher, then you must take it to a place that feels like home.  And you MUST take it to where your gopher can smell its favorite food: blueleaf tubers!

The closest such place is the "trench" area of Razorfen Kraul.  If you open your crate near the trench, and your gopher can smell any nearby tubers, then he will venture out and follow you.
6bb719a7.title: Snufflenose Owner's Manual

80ccd26b.text:
All of our gophers are highly trained, and merely waving your command stick will send a nearby gopher into "search mode."  The gopher will then sniff for a tuber and if he smells one, he'll move toward it and dig it up.

If you wave the command stick again while the gopher is searching for a tuber, then it will stop its search and happily return to your side.

We are confident that you'll find our gophers well trained, useful and squeezably soft additions to your party!
80ccd26b.title: Snufflenose Owner's Manual

86e6ff83.text:
FEEDING AND CARE:

We are committed to providing you with everything needed to care for your pet.  Our customers have come to expect this level of service from Snuff Inc, and we agree!

To that end, we have designed sturdy gopher crates with small holes, perfect for keeping your pet safe, secure and out of the light.

For your convenience, inside every crate is a food pellet receptacle, infused with the alluring scent of blueleaf tubers (the snufflenose gopher's favorite treat)!
86e6ff83.title: Snufflenose Owner's Manual

ae49717f.text:
CONGRATULATIONS!

You are the proud new owner of the amazing snufflenose gopher!  Although a shy creature, we are positive you'll find your new pet's fuzzy cuteness and incredible olfactory capabilities endearing.

In the following pages, you'll find information on your gopher's:

1. Feeding and care
2. Eccentric (and adorable) behavior
3. Use of the patented Snufflenose Command Stick(tm)

Again, congratulations.  You won't be disappounted,

-Marwig Rustbolt
Owner, Snuff Inc.
ae49717f.title: Snufflenose Owner's Manual

dd60b3b4.text:
THE SNUFFLENOSE COMMAND STICK(tm)

The snufflenose gopher is an amazing animal.  Not only does it inspire love and affection from even the most ornery plainstrider, it can smell a buried blueleaf tuber from up to fifty yards away!

If you wish to send your gopher to find a tuber, then you may use our (separately sold) patented snufflenose  command stick.  

Direction following on next page...
dd60b3b4.title: Snufflenose Owner's Manual

10378|8b4f80e7.name: Omusa Thunderhorn
10378|8b4f80e7.text: Though the Crossroads seems to be the center of activity in The Barrens, I prefer the quietude of Camp Taurajo.  Where shall I send you?

11084|87a66ee0.name: Tarn
11084|87a66ee0.text: I cannot help you with further training: your skill at working with leather rivals my own. You should speak with Una, over there. I will vouch for your skill if need be.

11116|e013de07.name: Innkeeper Abeqwa
11116|e013de07.text: As the wind on the plains, you are always welcome here.

11869|49ff395c.name: Ansekhwa
11869|49ff395c.text: I would be honored to train you in the use of the weapons that I have mastered should you have the ability to learn within you.

16227|c5ceacbe.name: Bragok
16227|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

2995|bfaf54b7.name: Tal
2995|bfaf54b7.text: When mounted on the back of a wind rider, one sees that its reputation for strength and speed is well earned.

3007|501c3600.name: Una
3007|501c3600.text: Cairne has brought us to a land rich with possibilities for the future. We have been fortunate, and so in turn we pass on our good fortune to others. That is why I began teaching, $N.

3008|d055944a.name: Mak
3008|d055944a.text: Your talent is beyond my own, friend. Speak with Tarn here; his knowledge of leather is much greater than mine. I'm sure he would welcome another student.

3310|cc0cf280.name: Doras
3310|cc0cf280.text: You haven't lived until you've looked down on the world from the back of a wind rider.

3430|d6fdd5ef.name: Mangletooth
3430|d6fdd5ef.text:
You have <snort> aided Mangletooth more than I would have dreamed, $r.

Thank you.

As long as I remain a captive here, you may bring me blood shards from the Bristleback quilboar and I will bless you with Agamaggan's power.

3433|4ec00f6f.name: Tatternack Steelforge
3433|4ec00f6f.text:
The Warchief has instructed me to study all kinds of weapons and armor. He has sent me here to the hub of both the tauren and orc cultures in the Barrens to meet as many travelers as possible, and to learn about the cultures of the Barrens.

He feels there's something to be learned from even the most pathetic of cultures... like the quilboar or centaur.

3442|c0ad1190.name: Sputtervalve
3442|c0ad1190.text: Lots to do, lots to do! The Union's given us deadlines and they're not the sort you want to miss!

3615|ddd7878b.name: Devrak
3615|ddd7878b.text: My wind riders are trained to fly quickly through the hot Barrens air.

4877|fe134d60.name: Jandia
4877|fe134d60.text: Hail, friend. Can I interest you in any of my trade supplies?

1095-accept.name: Sputtervalve
1095-accept.text:
The matter of this gnome that has been hired by the Venture Company has caused a bit of a stir in Undermine. The trade princes do not approve of Razdunk's consorting with this Gerenzo.

Riddlevox has asked me to take care of the problem, and I'm sure he was instructed to do so by one or more of the trade princes. Of course, the Director didn't tell me that. Let's just say I have a hunch.

Whatever the case, Gerenzo must be removed, and it would be a fitting test to have Fizziks take care of him.
1095-accept.title: Further Instructions

1102-complete.name: Auld Stonespire
1102-complete.text:
I see the nasty tribe of Razorfen Kraul now knows the pain of my people. Serves the foul beasts right.

To drive one from a holy land is a sin worthy of the most severe revenge.

Thank you, $N, for aiding me in my plight.
1102-complete.title: A Vengeful Fate

1102-progress.name: Auld Stonespire
1102-progress.text:
Once I know the foul beasts of Razorfen Kraul have been driven from their foul lair, I will be able to rest in peace, knowing that revenge has been served.

Have you the driven the quilboar from the Kraul? Do you bring to me good news in the form of Razorflank's heart?
1102-progress.title: A Vengeful Fate

1144-accept.name: Unknown
1144-accept.text:
At last, help has arrived!

You have no clue how long I've been held prisoner here. I can't remember the last time I saw the outside of this place.

You see, I am an entrepreneur. Always out for a copper, as they say. I caught wind that Mebok Mizzyrix was paying well for Redleaf Tuber from this here pig pen. I figured it would be an easy in, easy out kind of affair. As you can see, I was a bit wrong!

Anyway, if you'd be so kind as to help me get out of here, I'll make it worth your while.
1144-accept.title: Willix the Importer

1144-complete.name: Unknown
1144-complete.text: Thanks again, friend! I told you I'd make it worth your while.
1144-complete.title: Willix the Importer

1149-accept.name: Dorn Plainstalker
1149-accept.text:
So, you have sought me out, or perhaps destiny brings you to me? No matter. You are here now, and so your journey will begin anew.

Many facets make up a being: the spirit, the body, the mind. Some of these can be measured by a culture's traditions. Others we can only hope exist within ourselves. If you agree, I shall test some of the facets within you.

If you pass, then you shall become stronger. If you fail, then you will realize the vastness of the Nether.

The first is a Test of Faith.
1149-accept.title: Test of Faith

1149-complete.name: Dorn Plainstalker
1149-complete.text:
It is not until faced with unforeseen adversity that we begin to see how strong our spirits are. You took the leap of faith even though you had no guarantees that you would survive. Your mind is open, and your spirit is prepared for what is to come.

If you are willing, then the next of your tests is ready.
1149-complete.title: Test of Faith

1150-accept.name: Dorn Plainstalker
1150-accept.text:
I'm pleased to see your courage remains steadfast in light of what you've already done. Since your faith is intact, the time has come to test your body.

First is a test of endurance. Go with friends to the Roguefeather Den west of Freewind Post. Make your way to the depths of their lair and destroy their foodstuffs. By then you should have provoked their fury, and if you are able to survive long enough, Grenka Bloodscreech herself will come for you--kill her and bring me her claw to complete your test.
1150-accept.title: Test of Endurance

1153-complete.name: Tatternack Steelforge
1153-complete.text:
A good sample, $N. A good sample indeed.

Those travelers can no longer lord over me the ore they found, now that you have been successful.

I shall get to work on it immediately. If it proves strong enough, I will send a weapon crafted from the material back to the warchief to show him our success.

I shall not forget your help, $c.
1153-complete.title: A New Ore Sample

1153-progress.name: Tatternack Steelforge
1153-progress.text:
I saw the travelers again--the ones that would not sell me a sample of the ore. I spit at them for not helping the warchief.

May they die in battle like cowards and not like warriors as should be the right of all people who ally themselves with the Horde.
1153-progress.title: A New Ore Sample

1221-complete.name: Mebok Mizzyrix
1221-complete.text:
Great, you got them!  I can sell these to my contacts for a bundle!

Thanks for the delivery, $N!  You are a great partner.
1221-complete.title: Blueleaf Tubers

4542-accept.name: Brave Moonhorn
4542-accept.text:
Brave traveler, the centaurs have increased their attacks in this area. Freewind Post must know about this renewed harassment immediately! Seek Cliffwatcher Longhorn at Freewind Post to the southeast and give him this urgent message.

Be warned, avoid the Grimtotem Clan nearby... they have been acting strange toward us lately.
4542-accept.title: Message to Freewind Post

4542-complete.name: Cliffwatcher Longhorn
4542-complete.text: More bad news! These centaurs have gone too far! They raided one of my supply caravans and slaughtered the whole party. This is an outrage, and it will not go unpunished!
4542-complete.title: Message to Freewind Post

4542-progress.name: Cliffwatcher Longhorn
4542-progress.text: What do you want, $c? An urgent message - for me?
4542-progress.title: Message to Freewind Post

4767-accept.name: Elu
4767-accept.text:
I've been tasked to recruit more wyverns for the master wind riders. Their numbers are growing and I myself hope to become a wind rider one day. However, we cannot train enough wyverns to keep up with the demand. Perhaps you can help me, $N.

I need you to travel to Highperch to gather some wyvern eggs. From here, head northwest along the canyon walls to a ramp that will lead you into Highperch. Be careful, wyverns are very protective over their eggs and they will not be kind to intruders.
4767-accept.title: Wind Rider

4821-accept.name: Hagar Lightninghoof
4821-accept.text:
A rumor has surfaced about an alien egg here in Thousand Needles. Those that report seeing this egg have failed to even get close enough to examine it in detail. Serpents guard the egg as if it's one of their own.

I want you to seek out this alien egg and bring it to me so that I may examine it. Reports say the egg is located within a serpent den, but there are several serpent dens along the base of the cliff walls south and northeast of Freewind Post.
4821-accept.title: Alien Egg

4841-accept.name: Cliffwatcher Longhorn
4841-accept.text: $N, I entreat you to hunt these centaur down. They shall feel the wrath of our revenge. Attack the centaur camp to the north of Freewind Post!  Let wrath guide your hand!
4841-accept.title: Pacify the Centaur

5042-complete.name: Mangletooth
5042-complete.text:
If only Mangletooth were free to see you decimate those who betrayed him! <snort>

I thank you for destroying more of the Bristleback by gathering these shards. Please, continue to do so, and I will continue to aid you. <snort>
5042-complete.title: Agamaggan's Strength

5042-progress.name: Mangletooth
5042-progress.text:
I will need 4 blood shards if you wish Agamaggan's strength, $r.

Your foes will cower before your strength were you to be given this blessing. <snort>

The Razormane's greatest warriors are infused with such power!
5042-progress.title: Agamaggan's Strength

5151-accept.name: Wizlo Bearingshiner
5151-accept.text:
I am the only survivor from our caravan attack by the centaur! A rare yet mighty panther is guarding my best gizmo, which is around his neck. Hah! Even the centaur tremble in the presence of this ferocious beast!

Here is the key to the cage. They took everything there, but left him alone. Slay this beast and bring back my hypercapacitor, and I shall reward you.

The wrecked caravan is just north of here.
5151-accept.title: Hypercapacitor Gizmo

6522-accept.name: Unknown
6522-accept.text:
My Lady,

You know very well what it is we are offering. The opportunity for you to take the Barrens and the lands beyond is a great one. We simply want your aid in return. By aid we mean nothing more than your giving us the freedom to take action in the area.

Please, allow us to discuss this further. We have great power and are willing to share with those wise enough to join us. I will remain outside Razorfen Downs for the time being.

Best Regards,
Ambassador Malcin
6522-accept.title: An Unholy Alliance

79360-progress.name: Rau Cliffrunner
79360-progress.text: Danger? There's been no reports of anything like that. And our wind riders are far too busy to spend their time chasing ghost stories.
79360-progress.title: Elemental Aid

79364-accept.name: Rau Cliffrunner
79364-accept.text:
The note you found says the Razormane have burrowed into the Thousand Needles for some sort of unseen ritual. Raging storms and rising tides...

The quilboar must be using some cruel sorcery they learned from Hirzek, a $c who went to great lengths to twist the elements. If they plan to flood the canyon, this would require devastating elemental powers.

We are ill equipped to deal with this, but a powerful $c like you must have an idea. Return to your allies and see if you can't find an answer.
79364-accept.title: Eyes on the Sky

96136-complete.name: Prate Cloudseer
96136-complete.text: For the time being, I shall give you what you need to focus your spells and to call upon the spirits of air. Take this totem, and when you are ready, train with me some more.
96136-complete.title: Call of Air
